bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING... Combined seas 9 to 12 ft. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 315 PM Monday, 345 AM Tuesday, and 400 PM Tuesday. The Monday afternoon and Tuesday afternoon ebbs will be very strong.
bar.ebb: afternoon ebbs will be very strong
